_meta.purpose: Placeholder writing-level eval cases — paragraph cohesion, register, discourse-pragmatic transfer. The current L1 detector is sentence-level grammar only, so most cases here are expected_failure (gap markers) waiting for C2's writing-quality coverage.
source_notes: Seed cases authored by C5 (2026-05-24) for harness shape validation. C2 will populate the bulk with corpus-grounded writing samples.

Family names anticipate C2's likely categories (register-overformal, paragraph-topic-fronting, redundant-calque, apology-explanation-order, formality-mismatch) — they are not detector tag names. C2 may rename.
All entries are marked source honestly: 'invented' or 'docs/placement-vn-l1-interference-taxonomy.md' where the pattern is rooted in existing taxonomy work.
Mark NEW corpus-sourced cases with source: 'corpus' when C2 swaps them in.
